relationship_description: Bam Aquino is the cousin of former President Benigno 'Noynoy' Aquino III, both members of the Aquino political dynasty.
Bam Aquino (Paolo Benigno Aquino IV) is the brother of Paulo Benigno Aquino, both from the Aquino dynasty.
Bam Aquino is the grandson of Corazon Aquino, former President of the Philippines, both from the Aquino dynasty.
